messages.subject: Omni completion
parts:
Hello,
if I start R from VIM, and open Object Browser, an error "VimCom port not found" is given, but I am able to see variables under both manues in Object Browser. Omni cimpletion works, but populates only functions supplied with R by defualt, not variables that I have defined in the workspace. However, if I run :RpluginConfig this problem goes away. Is this a normal behavior?
Thank you!

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: Omni completion
parts:
The "VimCom port" is opened by the R package vimcom.plus. When the vimcom.plus library is loaded, it checks if the environment variable VIMRPLUGIN_TMPDIR is set. If R was started by Vim, the variable will be set and, then, the vimcom.plus package starts a server listening on port 9999. So, you have to load the vimcom.plus every time that you start R. However, instead of doing this manually, you can put in your .Rprofile:

library(vimcom.plus)

The command :RpluginConfig puts the above line in the user's Rprofile. Thus the command :RpluginConfig should be run only once.

messages.subject: Re: Omni completion
parts:
On Wednesday, January 22, 2014 9:26:20 PM UTC-3, yarosla...@gmail.com wrote:
update: some variables from GlobalEnv list populate on C-X C-O, while some do not.

All R workspace variables should be available for omnicompletion. Of course, if you press ^X^O after some characters, these characters will be treated as the beginning of the object name to complete and only objects that have the same characters at the beginning of their names will populate the pop up menu.
